nodes.description: Address holding super admin privileges for token removal and admin rotation.
Two-step ownership transfer candidate address awaiting acceptance.
Minimum day delay before rewards can be claimed; gates claimAll/claimUpTo.
IERC20 STRONG token handle used for all deposits and payouts.
External sbControllerInterface used to read start day, max years and rewards.
External sbVotesInterface notified on every mine/unmine for vote accounting.
Timelock address authorised to change service and miner minimum mine amounts.
Minimum mine amount required for a miner to qualify for service status.
Minimum mine amount required for a miner to qualify as an active miner.
Per-miner balance of votes-only mining that can be withdrawn without rewards eligibility.
Mapping of day to total STRONG rewards received for that day.
Per-miner marker of the last day rewards were claimed for; guards double claims.
Admin-only function transferring STRONG out of the contract.
Admin-only function transferring STRONG to the burn address.
Admin-only function setting the pending super admin candidate.
Pending admin accepts ownership and becomes superAdmin.
Admin-only setter for the claim delay in days.
Timelock-only setter for the service minimum mine threshold.
Timelock-only setter for the miner minimum mine threshold.
Deposits STRONG on behalf of a miner, updates mine and votes accounting.
Controller-only hook that pulls rewards into the pool and credits dayRewards.
User deposits STRONG, updates per-miner and global mine arrays and votes.
User withdraws previously mined STRONG, updates accounting and votes then transfers tokens.
User deposits STRONG only for vote weight without reward eligibility.
Withdraws votes-only mined STRONG after decrementing the votes-only balance.
Claims all matured rewards for msg.sender after the delay check.
Claims matured rewards for msg.sender up to a caller supplied day.
Internal claim routine that computes rewards, marks the day claimed and re-enters mineFor.
Internal accounting routine updating day/amount/mine-second arrays using block.timestamp.
Computes the current day from block.timestamp, used by nearly every day-based check.
Iterates days to compute proportional rewards from dayRewards and mine seconds.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and for crediting mining.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving day boundaries and mine-second weights.
strongToken.transferFrom pulls user/controller funds into the pool before accounting updates.
strongToken.transfer sends STRONG back to the claimant/withdrawer.
External self-call this.mineFor(miner, rewards) inside _claim transfers the pool reward and re-enters state.
External call into sbVotes.updateVotes during mine/unmine flows.
Admin-only strongToken.transfer used by removeTokens and burnTokens.
Amount parameter of mine/mineFor/unmine and similar entry points.
Miner address parameter of mineFor and related view helpers.
Day parameter supplied by the caller in claimUpTo and view helpers.
Upper day bound passed into the internal _claim routine.
Starting day for reward accumulation inside _claim.
Candidate address stored by setPendingSuperAdmin.
Delay in days written to delayDays by setDelayDays.
New service minimum mine value set by updateServiceMinMine.
New miner minimum mine value set by updateMinerMinMine.
Locally cached current day derived from block.timestamp.
Locally resolved last claimed day used in claimAll/claimUpTo.
Accumulated reward amount computed in _getRewardsDue.
block.timestamp modulo one day, used to weight mine seconds in _update.
Year derived from current day and start day to enforce the max years cap.

edges.reason: removeTokens is gated by require(msg.sender == superAdmin).
burnTokens is gated by require(msg.sender == superAdmin).
setPendingSuperAdmin is gated by require(msg.sender == superAdmin).
acceptSuperAdmin is gated by require(msg.sender == pendingSuperAdmin).
setDelayDays is gated by require(msg.sender == superAdmin).
updateServiceMinMine is gated by require(msg.sender == sbTimelock).
updateMinerMinMine is gated by require(msg.sender == sbTimelock).
msg.sender is the depositor whose tokens are pulled by mineFor.
receiveRewards is gated by require(msg.sender == address(sbController)).
msg.sender funds the deposit and is credited in mine.
msg.sender's mine accounting is decremented and tokens are refunded in unmine.
msg.sender deposit is recorded in mineForVotes and votes are updated.
msg.sender's votes-only balance is debited before payout.
msg.sender determines which miner account claimAll settles rewards for.
msg.sender determines which miner account claimUpTo settles rewards for.
_getCurrentDay derives the day directly from block.timestamp, making flows timestamp dependent.
_update uses block.timestamp to weight mine seconds, creating timestamp dependency.
claimAll compares the timestamp-derived current day against dayLastClaimedFor plus delayDays.
claimUpTo validates the requested day against the timestamp-derived current day.
mine records the timestamp-derived current day into the accounting arrays.
unmine uses the timestamp-derived current day to locate the state array entry.
delayDays is read by claimAll to enforce the claim delay.
delayDays is read by claimUpTo to enforce the claim delay.
mineFor pulls the deposit with strongToken.transferFrom when not self-called.
mine pulls the deposit with strongToken.transferFrom before updating state.
receiveRewards pulls controller rewards via strongToken.transferFrom.
unmine transfers the withdrawn STRONG back to the caller.
unmineForVotesOnly transfers the withdrawn STRONG back to the caller.
removeTokens performs an admin strongToken.transfer.
burnTokens performs an admin strongToken.transfer to the burn address.
_claim performs the external self-call this.mineFor(miner, rewards), a reentrancy entry point.
The external self-call re-enters mineFor, which mutates miner accounting and notifies sbVotes.
claimAll delegates the payout logic to _claim.
claimUpTo delegates the payout logic to _claim.
_claim computes the owed amount through _getRewardsDue.
_claim writes the new minerDayLastClaimedFor marker before the external self-call.
mine updates per-miner and global accounting through _update.
mineFor updates per-miner and global accounting through _update.
unmine decrements accounting through _update with adding set to false.
mine calls the external sbVotes.updateVotes hook after accounting changes.
mineFor calls the external sbVotes.updateVotes hook.
unmine calls the external sbVotes.updateVotes hook before transferring tokens out.
mineForVotesOnly calls the external sbVotes.updateVotes hook.
unmineForVotesOnly calls the external sbVotes.updateVotes hook.
mineFor reads start day and max years from the external sbController.
mine reads start day and max years from the external sbController.
mineForVotesOnly reads start day and max years from the external sbController.
_getRewardsDue reads dayRewards to proportionally allocate rewards.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is consumed directly by the mine entry point for deposit accounting.
The miner parameter is the credited account in mineFor.
The day parameter bounds the claim range in claimUpTo.
upToDay is the upper bound handed to the internal _claim routine.
dayLastClaimedFor seeds the reward accumulation loop in _claim.
The new candidate address is stored by setPendingSuperAdmin.
dayCount is validated and written to delayDays by setDelayDays.
The parameter is validated and stored by updateServiceMinMine.
The parameter is validated and stored by updateMinerMinMine.
The cached day value is produced by _getCurrentDay and reused across entry points.
The resolved last claimed day is used by claimAll to enforce the delay.
The accumulator lives inside the _getRewardsDue loop.
The timestamp remainder is computed and used inside _update.
The derived year is checked against MAX_YEARS inside mineFor.
